technology_type: Peptide digests (2 μg) from LiP-MS and tryptic digestion-only proteome samples were analyzed on an LTQ Orbitrap Velos (Thermo Fisher Scientific, San Jose, CA) mass spectrometer coupled to nanoflow liquid chromatography on an EASYnLC system (Proxeon Biosystems, Odense, DK) with a Proxeon nanoelectrospray ion source.
